content: VERIFIED from official docs (docs.bullmq.io/guide/jobs/repeatable, fetched 2026-09-08): the repeat option and Repeat API are deprecated since BullMQ 5.16.0 and REMOVED in v6, replaced by Job Schedulers: upsertJobScheduler, getJobSchedulers, removeJobScheduler. Scheduler config lives in Redis. Missed runs are NOT backfilled: if no workers are running, repeatable jobs do not accumulate. The next iteration is enqueued when the current one STARTS processing, so a job slower than its interval makes a single worker fall behind permanently. jobId for repeatables generates unique per-iteration ids, it is not a dedupe id. Upserting with the same scheduler key updates the config idempotently (good for re-declare at worker boot).
